complexity.notes: A true O(n) solution exists: build the table once with ||the recurrence dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1), reusing an already-computed answer|| instead of re-counting each number from scratch. Also, on modern Python i.bit_count() is the idiomatic spelling of hammingWeight and removes the helper entirely.
complexity.summary: For each i in [0, n], counts set bits by repeatedly taking i % 2 and halving, so each number costs O(log n) bit-extraction steps and the whole table costs O(n log n). The O(n) space is the required output array itself; auxiliary space is O(1).
